image_distribution: Host-local immutable image ID, pull_policy=never; exact image.tar retained at source_release_path. No registry publication claimed.
expired_historical_offerings: Authenticated immutable archives and individual members remain available after lease expiry and cold restart; expired updates are not installable.
offline_root_location: Operator workstation server/secrets/netcap-db-signing/root.key; never transferred to host

verification.clean_go_and_rust_cli_installs: full public archive, all members and source offerings byte-verified; subsequent signed refresh accepted
verification.scope: Targeted integration qualification; no claim of full estate or platform-release qualification

release_plan.source_commit: Parent coordinates after reviewing enrichment, producer artifacts, runtime bridges and deployment receipt; do not commit unrelated work.
release_plan.client_version: Parent assigns actual Go/Rust release versions after integration qualification; no minimum software version invented.
release_plan.client_install: net util --download-enrichment [--enrichment-root PATH] [--enrichment-url URL]; independent opt-in, NC_ENRICHMENT_ROOT defaults to NC_CONFIG_ROOT/enrichment.
release_plan.renewal: Use the existing offline root to delegate the next existing core signer certificate with -mode delegate; transfer only the resulting public scoped certificate. Update optional service key/certificate paths explicitly.
release_plan.restore_serving_image: Load retained image.tar from source_release_path and deploy the same pinned compose image ID; retain host_data and scoped trust.
release_plan.data_rollback: Republish retained reviewed bytes with a strictly higher optional-channel sequence using a valid scoped signer. Never replay an older signed pointer.
release_plan.source_offering: Keep authenticated historical archives and digest-addressed individual member URLs available for the complete ODbL derivative, full licenses, notices and provenance. The serving container follows atomic pointer refresh without restart.
